title: [Master]-Rounding Differences in ARAP with Deferrals and Non-Deductible VAT
summary: Gen. Jnl.-Post Line (codeunit 12) is changed in 11 localization layers to fix rounding differences in receivables and payables when deferrals and non-deductible VAT are combined. Tests for non-deductible VAT were added in W1 and IT.
key_points: Fixes rounding differences when posting with deferrals and non-deductible VAT
Same change applied in W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO and RU
New tests in the W1 and IT NonDedVATMisc test codeunits
Changes the core posting logic in codeunit 12
